text.p: Shares in Scotia Holdings Plc dropped on Tuesday as analysts at Greig Middleton issued a "sell" rating on the biotechnology stock along with a current "fair value" of just 220p per share.
Scotia was down 39-1/2p at 640 by 1340 GMT in volume of 251,631 shares.

"Investors in Scotia have seen an excellent share price performance," said analyst John Savin, "buoyed by optimism about the commercial prospects of a range of drugs based on natural oils for diabetes and cancer plus a strong photodynamic therapy product for cancer."
"However shareholders may have a very difficult period ahead as products are unlikely to be launched as quickly as anticipated and their sales potential is much lower than generally realised."
Savin said Scotia's overall sales had declined yet its costs were increasing, raising the prospect of a rights issue in the short-to-medium term.
